title: Exit code 2 from a PermissionRequest hook does not deny the permission
symptoms: The permission flow continues unchanged after the hook exits 2
The hook's stderr reason is discarded
cause: PermissionRequest is one of the events where exit code 2 is not honored; a deny has to come back as a decision object in JSON. PostToolUse, Notification, and SessionStart cannot block either.
fix: Print a hookSpecificOutput decision with behavior deny and exit 0, or move the check to PreToolUse, where exit 2 blocks the call.
